entries.claim_boundary: This exact functional-analytic result proves dense nonclosed range for one real-characteristic p-primary block in every unweighted full-time Sobolev realization H^(s+2)(R)->H^s(R), hence obstructs Fredholm and implicit-function promotion of the finite exponential-polynomial theorem in that category. It does not analyze weighted/radiation spaces, finite time slabs, a compact-Cauchy elliptic constraint map, causal/retarded solutions, nonlinear existence, stability, observables, particles, scattering, positivity or quantum theory.

dispersion.statement: The witness uses the exact p shell omega^2=16/3.

lee_wald.statement: No continuous Sobolev completion of the Lee-Wald form is certified here.

resonance.statement: The real characteristic zero creates the normalized approximate kernel.

bounded_or_finite_quasiperiodic.statement: Unweighted spacetime Sobolev closed range fails before a bounded inverse can be defined.

causal_retarded.statement: No weighted or retarded realization is analyzed.

smooth_secular.statement: The finite exponential-polynomial theorem remains separate and certified.

taub_maps.statement: Finite EP Taub covectors remain certified; their compact-Cauchy Sobolev adjoint realization is open.

scope.boundaries: closed S1_L x S2 spatial slice, unweighted R time
scope.carrier: one complemented generic ell=2,k=0 p-primary master block inside the candidate Sobolev completion
scope.charge_sector: fixed magnetic U(1) bundle P_N, N=2
scope.degree: linear closed-range gate; quadratic consequences only as failed prerequisites
scope.parity: either certified generic parity; one block suffices
